description: USE WHEN you want the probability that SPY, QQQ, GLD or TLT is in each market regime on trading day 5 or 21. Model-conditional probabilities of BULL / SIDEWAYS / BEAR / CRISIS (operational trailing-vol/drift labels) on trading day 5 or 21, not at any point before it: stress tools answer 'what happens GIVEN regime X', this answers 'how likely is X from today's state'. Uses the preregistered covariate logit; persistence and unconditional baselines are reported beside it. On GLD at 21 days it did not beat persistence (p=0.64), so that cell uses persistence, as market_regime_map does; model.tier says which. Assets: SPY, QQQ, GLD, TLT (GOLD accepted for GLD). Optional as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) evaluates a past date. Class membership on a future day, not a forecast of returns or direction, not advisory.

as_of.description: Optional historical evaluation date (YYYY-MM-DD); empty = latest data.
as_of.title: As Of

asset.description: One of the out-of-sample-validated assets: 'SPY', 'QQQ', 'GLD', 'TLT' (GOLD is read as GLD).
asset.title: Asset

horizon_days.description: The trading day the probabilities refer to, counted from the evaluation date. Validated: 5 or 21.
horizon_days.title: Horizon Days

name: regime_outlook
title: Regime-probability outlook (validated assets, h=5/21)
